(* Section 1: Scan Cycle Timing & Heartbeat Accumulation *)
iCycleCounter := iCycleCounter + 1;

IF (iMachineState <> iPreviousState) THEN

(* Section 2: 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) Sensor Voting Algorithms *)
(* 2.1 Tank Ullage Pressure Voting (PT101A, PT101B, PT101C) *)
IF (ABS(rPress_TankUllage_PT101A - rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) > rTMR_Tol_Press_Bar) THEN
    IF (ABS(rPress_TankUllage_PT101A - rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Press_Bar) THEN

ELSIF (ABS(rPress_TankUllage_PT101B - rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Press_Bar) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Persistent Discrepancy Debounce Filter (10 scans = 200 ms) *)
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_PT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_PT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_PT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

(* Voting Logic with Dynamic Channel Degradation *)
IF (bHealthy_PT_A AND bHealthy_PT_B AND bHealthy_PT_C) THEN
    (* True 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101A >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) OR
       ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101A <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_bar := rPress_TankUllage_PT101A;
    ELSIF ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101B >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101A) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101B <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) OR
          ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101B <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101A) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101B >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_bar := rPress_TankUllage_PT101B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankPress_bar := rPress_TankUllage_PT101C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_PT_A AND bHealthy_PT_B) THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_bar := (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A + rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_PT_B AND bHealthy_PT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_bar := (rPress_TankUllage_PT101B + rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_PT_A AND bHealthy_PT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_bar := (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A + rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    (* Dual Channel Failure - Force Emergency Trip *)
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: PT101 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Submerged Tank Liquid Temperature Voting (TT101A, TT101B, TT101C) *)
IF (ABS(rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A - rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) > rTMR_Tol_Temp_K) THEN
    IF (ABS(rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A - rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Temp_K) THEN

ELSIF (ABS(rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B - rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Temp_K) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B - 1; END_IF;

END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_TT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_TT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_TT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

IF (bHealthy_TT_A AND bHealthy_TT_B AND bHealthy_TT_C) THEN
    IF ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) OR
       ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_K := rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A;
    ELSIF ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) OR
          ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_K := rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankTemp_K := rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_TT_A AND bHealthy_TT_B) THEN
    rVoted_TankTemp_K := (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A + rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_TT_B AND bHealthy_TT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankTemp_K := (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B + rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_TT_A AND bHealthy_TT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankTemp_K := (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A + rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: TT101 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.3 Cathode Compressor Air Mass Flow Voting (FT301A, FT301B, FT301C) *)
IF (ABS(rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A - rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) > rTMR_Tol_Flow_kg_h) THEN
    IF (ABS(rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A - rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) > rTMR_Tol_Flow_kg_h) THEN
        iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A + 1;
    ELSE
        iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B + 1;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B - rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) > rTMR_Tol_Flow_kg_h) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_FT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_FT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_FT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

IF (bHealthy_FT_A AND bHealthy_FT_B AND bHealthy_FT_C) THEN
    IF ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) OR
       ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) THEN
        rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A;
    ELSIF ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) OR
          ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) THEN
        rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_FT_A AND bHealthy_FT_B) THEN
    rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A + rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_FT_B AND bHealthy_FT_C) THEN
    rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B + rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_FT_A AND bHealthy_FT_C) THEN
    rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A + rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: FT301 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.4 High-Voltage Stack DC Current Voting (CT201A, CT201B, CT201C) *)
IF (ABS(rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A - rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) > rTMR_Tol_Current_A) THEN
    IF (ABS(rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A - rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) > rTMR_Tol_Current_A) THEN
        iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A + 1;
    ELSE
        iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B + 1;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B - rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) > rTMR_Tol_Current_A) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_CT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_CT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_CT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

IF (bHealthy_CT_A AND bHealthy_CT_B AND bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    IF ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) OR
       ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) THEN
        rVoted_StackCurrent_A := rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A;
    ELSIF ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) OR
          ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) THEN
        rVoted_StackCurrent_A := rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_StackCurrent_A := rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_CT_A AND bHealthy_CT_B) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent_A := (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A + rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_CT_B AND bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent_A := (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B + rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_CT_A AND bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent_A := (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A + rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: CT201 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* Degraded 1oo2 Status Evaluation *)
IF (NOT bHealthy_PT_A OR NOT bHealthy_PT_B OR NOT bHealthy_PT_C OR
    NOT bHealthy_TT_A OR NOT bHealthy_TT_B OR NOT bHealthy_TT_C OR
    NOT bHealthy_FT_A OR NOT bHealthy_FT_B OR NOT bHealthy_FT_C OR
    NOT bHealthy_CT_A OR NOT bHealthy_CT_B OR NOT bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rDegraded_RunTime_Sec := rDegraded_RunTime_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000001; (* Warning Bit 0: TMR Degraded Mode *)
ELSE
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Section 3: Physical Thermodynamics & Fluid Property Estimation *)
(* 3.1 Saturated Para-Hydrogen Vapor Pressure P_vap(T) Approximation [bar] *)
(* Antoine/NIST Polynomial approximation around 20K to 24K *)
rPress_Vapor_LH2 := 1.013 * EXP( (445.60 * rConst_MolarMass_H2 / 0.008314) * ( (1.0 / 20.28) - (1.0 / MAX(18.0, rVoted_TankTemp_K)) ) );
IF (rPress_Vapor_LH2 < 0.50) THEN rPress_Vapor_LH2 := 0.50; END_IF;
IF (rPress_Vapor_LH2 > 4.50) THEN rPress_Vapor_LH2 := 4.50; END_IF;

(* 3.2 Submerged Cryo-Pump NPSHa Calculation *)
(* Head = (P_ullage - P_vap) / (rho * g) + StaticHead - SuctionLineLoss *)
rNPSH_Available := ((rVoted_TankPress_bar - rPress_Vapor_LH2) * 1.0E5) / (rConst_Density_LH2 * rConst_Gravity_Acc) + 0.450;
rAct_NPSHa_CryoPump_Calc := rNPSH_Available;

(* Dynamic NPSH Required based on actual pump speed (quadratic affinity scaling) *)
rNPSH_Required := 1.20 + 2.50 * (rSpeed_SubmergedPump_ST101 / 25000.0) * (rSpeed_SubmergedPump_ST101 / 25000.0);

(* Cavitation Risk Monitoring *)
IF (rNPSH_Available < (rNPSH_Required + 0.250)) AND (rSpeed_SubmergedPump_ST101 > 4500.0) THEN
    rCavitation_Duration_Sec := rCavitation_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000002; (* Warning Bit 1: Low NPSHa Cavitation Hazard *)
    IF (rCavitation_Duration_Sec > 1.50) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000010; (* Alarm Bit 4: Cryo-Pump Severe Cavitation Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rCavitation_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rCavitation_Duration_Sec := rCavitation_Duration_Sec - (rCycleTime_Sec * 0.50);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 3.3 Supercritical Hydrogen Enthalpy Estimation at MCHX Exit [kJ/kg] *)
(* Near 15 bar, H2 warms from 20K (h ~ -250 kJ/kg ref) to 285K (h ~ 3950 kJ/kg) *)
rAct_SupercriticalH2_Enthalpy := 14.30 * (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 - 20.0) + (0.0045 * (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 * rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103));

(* Thermal Power Exchanged across MCHX core [kW] *)
(* Q = W_glycol * Cp_glycol * Delta_T_glycol *)
rGlycol_Temp_Delta := rTemp_Glycol_Supply_TT201 - rTemp_Glycol_Return_TT202;
rAct_MCHX_HeatExchanged_kW := (rFlow_GlycolCoolant_FT201 / 3600.0) * rConst_SpecificHeat_Glycol * MAX(0.0, rGlycol_Temp_Delta);

(* Boundary Wall Freezing Guard Evaluation *)
(* Harmonic boundary temperature estimation between warm glycol bulk and cold H2 *)
rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est := (0.65 * rTemp_Glycol_Return_TT202) + (0.35 * (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 - 273.15));
IF (rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est < -22.0) THEN
    rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec := rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000004; (* Warning Bit 2: MCHX Glycol Freeze Risk *)
    IF (rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec > 2.00) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000020; (* Alarm Bit 5: MCHX Glycol Freeze Protection Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec := rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec - rCycleTime_Sec;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 3.4 Cathode Compressor Pressure Ratio & Aerodynamic Surge Margin *)
rCompressor_PressureRatio := MAX(1.0, rPress_CathodeInlet_PT301) / MAX(0.20, rAmbient_Air_Press_PT001);
(* Surge mass flow characteristic line: W_surge = a * PR^2 + b * PR + c *)
rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h := 120.0 + 85.0 * (rCompressor_PressureRatio - 1.0) * (rCompressor_PressureRatio - 1.0);
IF (rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h > 10.0) THEN
    rAct_CompressorSurgeMargin_Pct := ((rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h - rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h) / rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rAct_CompressorSurgeMargin_Pct := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.5 Anode-to-Cathode Transmembrane Pressure Differential *)
rAct_TransmembraneDeltaP_bar := rPress_AnodeRegulated_PT102 - rPress_CathodeInlet_PT301;
IF (ABS(rAct_TransmembraneDeltaP_bar) > 0.40) AND (iMachineState >= 70) THEN
    rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec := rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000020; (* Warning Bit 5: Transmembrane Delta-P High *)
    IF (rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec > 0.80) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00010000; (* Alarm Bit 16: Transmembrane Rupture Risk Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec := rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec - rCycleTime_Sec;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Section 4: Submerged Cryo-Boost Pump & BOG Pressure Modulation Logic *)
rBOG_Pressure_Error := rVoted_TankPress_bar - 2.300; (* Target ullage pressure = 2.30 bar *)
rBOG_Pressure_Integral := rBOG_Pressure_Integral + (rBOG_Pressure_Error * rCycleTime_Sec * 0.40);
IF (rBOG_Pressure_Integral > 100.0) THEN rBOG_Pressure_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
IF (rBOG_Pressure_Integral < 0.0) THEN rBOG_Pressure_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Proportional-Integral Modulating Relief Valve CV101 *)
rBOG_Relief_Cmd := (rBOG_Pressure_Error * 65.0) + rBOG_Pressure_Integral;
IF (rBOG_Relief_Cmd > 100.0) THEN rBOG_Relief_Cmd := 100.0; END_IF;
IF (rBOG_Relief_Cmd < 0.0) THEN rBOG_Relief_Cmd := 0.0; END_IF;
rCmd_BOG_ReliefValve_CV101 := rBOG_Relief_Cmd;

(* Emergency Discrete Solenoid Vent Valve Command for Rapid De-pressurization *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_bar > 3.400) THEN
    bBOG_VentValve_Open := TRUE;
    rOverpressure_Duration_Sec := rOverpressure_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    IF (rOverpressure_Duration_Sec > 3.00) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000040; (* Alarm Bit 6: Tank Ullage Extreme Overpressure *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF (rVoted_TankPress_bar < 2.900) THEN
    bBOG_VentValve_Open := FALSE;
    rOverpressure_Duration_Sec := 0.000;
END_IF;

(* Recompression Buffer Compressor ST102 Modulation *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_bar > 2.400) AND (iMachineState >= 70) THEN
    rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP := 8000.0 + (rVoted_TankPress_bar - 2.400) * 12000.0;
    IF (rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP > 20000.0) THEN rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP := 20000.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Submerged Cryo-Pump Speed Demand governed by Fuel Cell Current *)
(* Flow demand: W_H2 = (I_fc * N_cells / (2*F)) * M_H2 * 3600 [kg/h] *)
rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd := 4500.0 + (rVoted_StackCurrent_A / 1875.0) * 19500.0;
(* Anti-Cavitation Speed Truncation: clamp pump speed if NPSHa is degraded *)
IF (rNPSH_Available < (rNPSH_Required + 0.40)) THEN
    IF (rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd > 14000.0) THEN rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd := 14000.0; END_IF;
END_IF;
rCmd_CryoPumpSpeed_SP := rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd;

(* Section 5: Supercritical MCHX Glycol Thermal Rebalance & Anti-Freeze Logic *)
(* Closed-loop regulation of MCHX H2 exit temperature to 285 K *)
IF (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 < 275.0) OR (rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est < -10.0) THEN
    (* Close bypass valve to force maximum warm glycol flow through cryogenic core *)
    rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd - (rCycleTime_Sec * 25.0);
ELSIF (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 > 295.0) AND (rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est > 25.0) THEN
    (* Open bypass valve to prevent overheating and conserve thermal bus exergy *)
    rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd + (rCycleTime_Sec * 15.0);
END_IF;
IF (rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd > 85.0) THEN rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := 85.0; END_IF;
IF (rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd < 0.0)  THEN rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := 0.0;  END_IF;
rCmd_GlycolBypassValve_CV201 := rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd;
rCmd_GlycolCoolantPump_SP := 1800.0 + (rAct_FC_GrossPower_Calc / 1500.0) * 2200.0;

(* Section 6: 1.5 MW PEMFC Dynamic Cathode Air Stoichiometry *)
(* Faraday Electrochemical Consumption: W_O2 [kg/h] = (N_cells * I_fc / (4*F)) * M_O2 * 3600 *)
rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h := (INT_TO_REAL(iConst_Total_PEM_Cells) * rVoted_StackCurrent_A / (4.0 * rConst_Faraday)) * rConst_MolarMass_O2 * 3600.0;

(* Dynamic Stoichiometry Lambda Target Scheduling *)
IF (rVoted_StackCurrent_A < 300.0) THEN
    rLambda_O2_Target := 2.20; (* Higher excess ratio at idle to prevent cathode condensation flooding *)
ELSIF (bFlightTakeoffMode) THEN
    rLambda_O2_Target := 1.65; (* High power density mode: maximize stack efficiency and pressure *)
ELSE
    rLambda_O2_Target := 1.85; (* Cruise mode: balance parasitic compressor power and cell potential *)
END_IF;

(* Required Dry Air Mass Flow [kg/h] *)
rAir_MassRequired_kg_h := (rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h / rConst_DryAir_O2_MassFrac) * rLambda_O2_Target;
IF (rAir_MassRequired_kg_h < 120.0) AND (iMachineState >= 70) THEN
    rAir_MassRequired_kg_h := 120.0; (* Minimum idle purge airflow *)
END_IF;

(* Evaluated Real-Time Cathode Stoichiometric Ratio *)
IF (rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h > 1.0) THEN
    rLambda_O2_Actual := (rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h * rConst_DryAir_O2_MassFrac) / rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h;
ELSE
    rLambda_O2_Actual := 3.00;
END_IF;
rAct_CathodeStoichiometry_Calc := rLambda_O2_Actual;

(* Oxygen Starvation Guard Monitor *)
IF (rLambda_O2_Actual < 1.35) AND (rVoted_StackCurrent_A > 250.0) THEN
    rStarvation_Duration_Sec := rStarvation_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000008; (* Warning Bit 3: Oxygen Starvation Alert *)
    IF (rStarvation_Duration_Sec > 0.400) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000080; (* Alarm Bit 7: Critical Cathode Starvation Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rStarvation_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rStarvation_Duration_Sec := rStarvation_Duration_Sec - (rCycleTime_Sec * 2.0);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Electric Turbo-Compressor Shaft Speed Command [rpm] *)
rCompressor_Speed_Cmd := 12000.0 + (rAir_MassRequired_kg_h / 2400.0) * 80000.0;
IF (rCompressor_Speed_Cmd > 95000.0) THEN rCompressor_Speed_Cmd := 95000.0; END_IF;
IF (rCompressor_Speed_Cmd < 10000.0) THEN rCompressor_Speed_Cmd := 10000.0; END_IF;
rCmd_CompressorSpeed_SP := rCompressor_Speed_Cmd;

(* Cathode Dynamic Backpressure Throttle Valve CV301 *)
(* Pressure target: 2.20 bar at cruise, up to 3.00 bar at takeoff *)
IF (bFlightTakeoffMode) THEN
    rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 55.0 + (rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h / 2400.0) * 35.0;
ELSE
    rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 35.0 + (rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h / 2400.0) * 45.0;
END_IF;

(* Anti-Surge Bleed Modulation *)
IF (rAct_CompressorSurgeMargin_Pct < 15.0) THEN
    (* Open cathode backpressure valve rapidly to relieve pressure and restore flow *)
    rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 10.0;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000010; (* Warning Bit 4: Compressor Surge Imminent *)
END_IF;

(* Section 7: 6x6 Discrete Linear State-Space Observer & Kalman Updates *)
(* Measurements y_meas: deviations from nominal operating point *)
y_meas[1] := rVoted_TankPress_bar - 2.300;
y_meas[2] := rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 - 285.0;
y_meas[3] := rTemp_Glycol_Return_TT202 - 68.0;
y_meas[4] := rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h - 1450.0;
y_meas[5] := rVoted_StackCurrent_A - 1250.0;
y_meas[6] := rVoltage_HVDC_Bus_VT201 - 800.0;

(* Estimated Outputs y_est = C * x_hat + D * u_opt *)
y_est[1] := C_mat[1,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[1,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[1,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[1,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[1,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[1,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[2] := C_mat[2,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[2,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[2,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[2,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[2,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[2,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[3] := C_mat[3,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[3,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[3,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[3,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[3,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[3,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[4] := C_mat[4,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[4,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[4,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[4,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[4,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[4,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[5] := C_mat[5,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[5,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[5,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[5,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[5,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[5,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[6] := C_mat[6,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[6,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[6,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[6,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[6,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[6,6]*x_hat[6];

(* State Innovation Prediction: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u_opt *)
x_pred[1] := A_mat[1,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[1,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[1,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[1,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[1,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[1,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[1,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[1,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[1,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[1,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[2] := A_mat[2,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[2,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[2,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[2,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[2,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[2,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[2,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[2,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[2,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[2,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[3] := A_mat[3,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[3,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[3,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[3,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[3,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[3,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[3,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[3,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[3,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[3,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[4] := A_mat[4,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[4,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[4,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[4,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[4,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[4,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[4,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[4,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[4,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[4,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[5] := A_mat[5,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[5,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[5,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[5,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[5,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[5,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[5,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[5,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[5,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[5,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[6] := A_mat[6,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[6,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[6,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[6,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[6,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[6,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[6,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[6,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[6,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[6,4]*u_opt[4];

(* Observer State Correction: x_hat = x_pred + L * (y_meas - y_est) *)
x_hat[1] := x_pred[1] + L_obs[1,1]*(y_meas[1] - y_est[1]);
x_hat[2] := x_pred[2] + L_obs[2,2]*(y_meas[2] - y_est[2]);
x_hat[3] := x_pred[3] + L_obs[3,3]*(y_meas[3] - y_est[3]);
x_hat[4] := x_pred[4] + L_obs[4,4]*(y_meas[4] - y_est[4]);
x_hat[5] := x_pred[5] + L_obs[5,5]*(y_meas[5] - y_est[5]);
x_hat[6] := x_pred[6] + L_obs[6,6]*(y_meas[6] - y_est[6]);

(* Section 8: Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Cost Fast Active-Set Solver *)
(* Analytical Quadratic Gradient: grad = B^T * Q * x_hat + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
rQP_Gradient[1] := (B_mat[1,1]*Q_weights[1]*x_hat[1] + B_mat[2,1]*Q_weights[2]*x_hat[2]) + R_weights[1]*u_opt[1] + S_weights[1]*(u_opt[1] - u_prev[1]);
rQP_Gradient[2] := (B_mat[2,2]*Q_weights[2]*x_hat[2] + B_mat[3,2]*Q_weights[3]*x_hat[3]) + R_weights[2]*u_opt[2] + S_weights[2]*(u_opt[2] - u_prev[2]);
rQP_Gradient[3] := (B_mat[4,3]*Q_weights[4]*x_hat[4])                                      + R_weights[3]*u_opt[3] + S_weights[3]*(u_opt[3] - u_prev[3]);
rQP_Gradient[4] := (B_mat[5,4]*Q_weights[5]*x_hat[5] + B_mat[6,4]*Q_weights[6]*x_hat[6]) + R_weights[4]*u_opt[4] + S_weights[4]*(u_opt[4] - u_prev[4]);

(* Diagonal Hessian Approximation *)
rQP_Hessian_Diag[1] := R_weights[1] + S_weights[1] + 0.05;
rQP_Hessian_Diag[2] := R_weights[2] + S_weights[2] + 0.10;
rQP_Hessian_Diag[3] := R_weights[3] + S_weights[3] + 0.04;
rQP_Hessian_Diag[4] := R_weights[4] + S_weights[4] + 0.02;

(* Projected Gradient Newton Step with Actuator Rate & Amplitude Constraints *)
u_opt[1] := u_opt[1] - (rQP_Gradient[1] / rQP_Hessian_Diag[1]) * 0.40;
u_opt[2] := u_opt[2] - (rQP_Gradient[2] / rQP_Hessian_Diag[2]) * 0.40;
u_opt[3] := u_opt[3] - (rQP_Gradient[3] / rQP_Hessian_Diag[3]) * 0.40;
u_opt[4] := u_opt[4] - (rQP_Gradient[4] / rQP_Hessian_Diag[4]) * 0.40;

(* Enforce Slew Rate & Absolute Actuator Saturation on MPC Outputs *)
IF (u_opt[1] > (u_prev[1] + u_rate_limit[1]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[1] := u_prev[1] + u_rate_limit[1]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
IF (u_opt[1] < (u_prev[1] - u_rate_limit[1]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[1] := u_prev[1] - u_rate_limit[1]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
IF (u_opt[2] > (u_prev[2] + u_rate_limit[2]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[2] := u_prev[2] + u_rate_limit[2]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
IF (u_opt[2] < (u_prev[2] - u_rate_limit[2]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[2] := u_prev[2] - u_rate_limit[2]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
IF (u_opt[3] > (u_prev[3] + u_rate_limit[3]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[3] := u_prev[3] + u_rate_limit[3]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
IF (u_opt[3] < (u_prev[3] - u_rate_limit[3]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[3] := u_prev[3] - u_rate_limit[3]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
IF (u_opt[4] > (u_prev[4] + u_rate_limit[4]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[4] := u_prev[4] + u_rate_limit[4]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
IF (u_opt[4] < (u_prev[4] - u_rate_limit[4]*rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN u_opt[4] := u_prev[4] - u_rate_limit[4]*rCycleTime_Sec; END_IF;
u_prev[1] := u_opt[1];
u_prev[2] := u_opt[2];
u_prev[3] := u_opt[3];
u_prev[4] := u_opt[4];

(* Section 9: High-Voltage DC Bus Active Current Slew Rate Limiter & Battery Split *)
(* Target stack current based on Powertrain Electrical Demand: I = P [kW] * 1000.0 / V_bus *)
IF (rVoltage_HVDC_Bus_VT201 > 500.0) THEN
    rCurrent_Cmd_Target := (rPower_PowertrainDemand_PW01 * 1000.0) / rVoltage_HVDC_Bus_VT201;
ELSE
    rCurrent_Cmd_Target := (rPower_PowertrainDemand_PW01 * 1000.0) / 800.0;
END_IF;
IF (rCurrent_Cmd_Target > 1875.0) THEN rCurrent_Cmd_Target := 1875.0; END_IF; (* 1.5 MW rated limit *)
IF (rCurrent_Cmd_Target < 0.0)    THEN rCurrent_Cmd_Target := 0.0;    END_IF;

(* Dynamic Slew Rate Adaptation based on Real-Time Air Stoichiometry *)
(* If lambda_O2 is high (> 2.0), accelerate slew up to 100 A/s; if low (< 1.6), decelerate to 30 A/s *)
IF (rLambda_O2_Actual >= 2.00) THEN
    rCurrent_Slew_Enforced := 95.00;
ELSIF (rLambda_O2_Actual <= 1.55) THEN
    rCurrent_Slew_Enforced := 30.00;
ELSE
    rCurrent_Slew_Enforced := 30.00 + (rLambda_O2_Actual - 1.55) * 144.44;
END_IF;
rCmd_HVDC_SlewRateActive := rCurrent_Slew_Enforced;

(* Discrete Slew Rate Clamping *)
IF (rCurrent_Cmd_Target > rCurrent_Cmd_Previous) THEN
    IF ((rCurrent_Cmd_Target - rCurrent_Cmd_Previous) > (rCurrent_Slew_Enforced * rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN
        rCurrent_Cmd_Previous := rCurrent_Cmd_Previous + (rCurrent_Slew_Enforced * rCycleTime_Sec);
    ELSE
        rCurrent_Cmd_Previous := rCurrent_Cmd_Target;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (rCurrent_Cmd_Target < rCurrent_Cmd_Previous) THEN
    (* Downward slew rate can be faster: 120 A/s to relieve load rapidly *)
    IF ((rCurrent_Cmd_Previous - rCurrent_Cmd_Target) > (120.0 * rCycleTime_Sec)) THEN
        rCurrent_Cmd_Previous := rCurrent_Cmd_Previous - (120.0 * rCycleTime_Sec);
    ELSE
        rCurrent_Cmd_Previous := rCurrent_Cmd_Target;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rCmd_HVDC_CurrentLimit_SP := rCurrent_Cmd_Previous;

(* Instantaneous Calculated Gross Fuel Cell Power [kW] *)
rAct_FC_GrossPower_Calc := (rVoted_StackCurrent_A * rVoltage_HVDC_Bus_VT201) / 1000.0;

(* Hybrid Li-ion Battery Power Split Reference [kW] *)
(* Battery absorbs the high-frequency difference between demand and ramp-limited fuel cell *)
rCmd_BatteryPowerAssist_SP := rPower_PowertrainDemand_PW01 - rAct_FC_GrossPower_Calc;

(* Section 10: Multi-Stage Deterministic Finite State Machine *)
CASE iMachineState OF
    0: (* STATE_COLD_POWERUP_INIT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bAlarmTripActive := FALSE;
        bWarningActive := FALSE;
        bBOG_VentValve_Open := FALSE;
        rCmd_CryoPumpSpeed_SP := 0.0;
        rCmd_CompressorSpeed_SP := 0.0;
        rCmd_HVDC_CurrentLimit_SP := 0.0;
        rCmd_BatteryPowerAssist_SP := 0.0;
        rCmd_GlycolBypassValve_CV201 := 50.0;
        rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 100.0;
        rCmd_AnodePurgeValve_CV102 := 0.0;
        IF bSystemEnable AND bEmergencyStop_TMR AND NOT bTripLatch THEN
            iMachineState := 10; (* Transition to TMR Sensor Alignment & Calibration *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_TMR_CALIBRATION_AND_SELFTEST *)
        (* Verify baseline sensor readings within valid pre-flight physical limits *)
        IF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec >= 2.00) THEN
            IF (rVoted_TankPress_bar >= 0.80) AND (rVoted_TankPress_bar <= 3.20) AND
               (rVoted_TankTemp_K >= 18.0) AND (rVoted_TankTemp_K <= 35.0) THEN
                iMachineState := 20; (* Proceed to Cryo Chilldown & Purge *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000100; (* Alarm Bit 8: Pre-flight Sensor Out of Range *)
                iMachineState := 190;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_CRYO_CHILLDOWN_AND_GN2_PURGE *)
        (* Circulate cold helium/hydrogen vapor to pre-chill delivery lines without thermal shock *)
        rCmd_GlycolCoolantPump_SP := 1500.0;
        rCmd_GlycolBypassValve_CV201 := 20.0;
        rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 100.0;
        IF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec >= 15.0) AND (rVoted_TankTemp_K <= 24.5) THEN
            iMachineState := 30; (* Proceed to LH2 Boost Pump Prime & BOG Stabilization *)
        ELSIF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec > 45.0) THEN
            dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000200; (* Alarm Bit 9: Chilldown Timeout *)
            iMachineState := 190;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_LH2_PUMP_PRIME_AND_BOG_STABILIZE *)
        (* Spin-up submerged boost pump to minimum idle speed and verify NPSHa *)
        rCmd_CryoPumpSpeed_SP := 5000.0;
        IF (rSpeed_SubmergedPump_ST101 >= 4600.0) AND (rNPSH_Available >= 2.50) THEN
            IF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec >= 5.0) THEN
                iMachineState := 40; (* Proceed to Supercritical MCHX Thermal Boot *)
            END_IF;
        ELSIF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec > 20.0) THEN
            dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000400; (* Alarm Bit 10: Pump Prime Failure *)
            iMachineState := 190;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_MCHX_SUPERCRITICAL_THERMAL_BOOT *)
        (* Transition hydrogen through transcritical regime and stabilize exit temp > 270 K *)
        rCmd_CryoPumpSpeed_SP := 6000.0;
        IF (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 >= 270.0) AND (rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est >= 5.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 50; (* Proceed to PEMFC Inert Purge & Cathode Warmup *)
        ELSIF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec > 30.0) THEN
            dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000800; (* Alarm Bit 11: MCHX Thermal Boot Timeout *)
            iMachineState := 190;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_PEMFC_ANODE_CATHODE_INERT_PURGE *)
        (* Sweep cathode with dry air at 12,000 rpm; modulate anode purge solenoid CV102 *)
        rCmd_CompressorSpeed_SP := 14000.0;
        rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 80.0;
        rCmd_AnodePurgeValve_CV102 := 100.0;
        IF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec >= 8.00) AND (rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h >= 140.0) THEN
            rCmd_AnodePurgeValve_CV102 := 0.0;
            iMachineState := 60; (* Proceed to HVDC Bus Precharge & Synchronization *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_HVDC_BUS_PRECHARGE_AND_SYNC *)
        (* Match fuel cell open-circuit voltage to propulsion DC bus *)
        rCmd_HVDC_CurrentLimit_SP := 50.0; (* Small bleed current to verify DC-DC converter firing *)
        IF (rVoltage_HVDC_Bus_VT201 >= 750.0) AND (rVoltage_HVDC_Bus_VT201 <= 950.0) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            iMachineState := 70; (* Ground Taxi / Flight Standby Idle *)
        ELSIF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec > 10.0) THEN
            dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00001000; (* Alarm Bit 12: HVDC Bus Precharge Fault *)
            iMachineState := 190;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_FLIGHT_GROUND_TAXI_IDLE *)
        (* Standby / ground taxi power ~ 150 kW to 250 kW *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        IF bFlightTakeoffMode THEN
            iMachineState := 80; (* Transition to Takeoff / Climb Full Power *)
        ELSIF bFlightCruiseMode THEN
            iMachineState := 90; (* Transition directly to Cruise Mode *)
        ELSIF NOT bSystemEnable THEN
            iMachineState := 110; (* Proceed to Ground Touchdown & Rollout Shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_FLIGHT_TAKEOFF_CLIMB_1500KW *)
        (* Maximum rated continuous power 1.5 MW. Strict dynamic slew limiting active *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        IF bFlightCruiseMode THEN
            iMachineState := 90; (* Transition to Level Cruise *)
        ELSIF bFlightDescentMode THEN
            iMachineState := 100; (* Transition to Flight Descent *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_FLIGHT_CRUISE_OPTIMAL_EFFICIENCY *)
        (* Optimal specific fuel consumption regime ~ 900 kW continuous *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        IF bFlightTakeoffMode THEN
            iMachineState := 80; (* Climb / Go-Around Power *)
        ELSIF bFlightDescentMode THEN
            iMachineState := 100; (* Transition to Flight Descent *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE_FLIGHT_DESCENT_APPROACH_RAMP *)
        (* Low-throttle approach power 200 kW. Anti-surge bleed valve armed *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        IF bFlightTakeoffMode THEN
            iMachineState := 80; (* Abort Approach / Go-Around *)
        ELSIF (rFlight_Altitude_ALT01 < 10.0) OR NOT bSystemEnable THEN
            iMachineState := 110; (* Touchdown Rollout *)
        END_IF;

    110: (* STATE_FLIGHT_TOUCHDOWN_ROLLOUT *)
        (* Controlled de-energization of fuel cell stacks and thermal stabilization *)
        rCmd_HVDC_CurrentLimit_SP := 0.0;
        rCmd_CryoPumpSpeed_SP := 4500.0;
        rCmd_CompressorSpeed_SP := 12000.0;
        IF (rStateTimeElapsed_Sec >= 20.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 0; (* Return to Cold Idle Powerup *)
        END_IF;

    120: (* STATE_DEGRADED_FAIL_OPERATIONAL *)
        (* Single stack sub-module isolated or TMR sensor dropped to 1oo2. De-rate to 60% *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        IF (rCurrent_Cmd_Target > 1125.0) THEN
            rCurrent_Cmd_Target := 1125.0; (* Hard 60% power cap (900 kW) *)
        END_IF;
        IF (dwAlarmsInternal <> 16#00000000) THEN
